descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-03 Search & Sort · S06 Nursing Home server search: another physician's resident, edits and '+ Today' while searching, removal

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 Nursing Home: search by name, by unit/room, by MRN and by facility each returns the correct matching residents, each field on its own. (UAT TC-03; TFA-92581 AC 3; TFA-92581 AC 6)
  • U7 Nursing Home: sort by room (unit/room), by name and by status each puts the residents in the correct order. (UAT TC-03; TFA-92581 AC 4; TFA-92581 AC 6)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Owner A, a fresh @roundai.test physician, with 'QA Resident Find-<tok> One' (unit 'Rm 5', status pending, in Today's Visits), 'QA Resident Find-<tok> Two' (unit 'Rm 2', status pre-rounded, All Residents only) and 'QA Resident Unrelated' (unit 'Rm 1'). …

When As A, call snf:listPage for Today's Visits and for All Residents with search 'Find-<tok>' under each sort (room, name, status), two rows a page. Then, with the search still applied: rename One to 'QA Resident Renamed-<tok2>' and back; change One's unit to 'Rm 1'; change One's status pending → note-ready; …

Then Foreign is never returned in either view, under any sort or on any page; Unrelated is never returned. Each edit re-filters and re-sorts at once. The rename drops One and the rename back returns it. The unit change moves One before Two in All Residents room order. The status change moves One after Two in status order. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Returned ids per page, view and sort, compared with the expected id lists above (U4 isolation and re-filtering, U7 re-sorting). Diagnosis is left out on purpose so the verdict does not depend on AC 3. Tim's snf variant of the server-search API test is not reused: it asserts NH diagnosis search finds the resident, which AC 3 forbids. Needs precondition P1

Where it ran: local newspec-a (new Playwright specs); test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S06 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-03.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-a.

Test method: API · API (Convex functions); secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both (single-account legs) / local (Foreign leg); Source: newspec-a.

UAT item: TC-03 Search & Sort · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-03/S06

Nursing Home server search: another physician's resident, edits and '+ Today' while searching, removal

Tickets: TFA-92581 Search & Sort (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-a: status passed in newspec-a/results.json → passed (passed).

How it is tested (newspec-a/plan.json, automatable: yes): New api spec: owner A (fresh) with One/Two/Unrelated, physician B (fresh) with Foreign; snf:listPage for today/all x room/name/status, 2 rows a page, following the cursor to isDone; then rename and back, unit change, status pending->note-ready, today toggle, remove, each followed at once by the same reads; compare returned id lists with the expected lists. — Server query + mutations only; two fresh accounts on the local stack.

Detail:

Owner A (One, Two, Unrelated) and physician B (Foreign), snf:listPage two rows a page followed to isDone: Foreign and Unrelated never returned in either view under any sort or page; initial order today [One], all room [Two, One], name [One, Two], status [One, Two]; rename away drops One at once and rename back returns it; unit Rm 1 moves One before Two (room); pending -> note-ready moves One after Two (status); + Today toggle moves Two in and One out of Today's Visits while both stay in All Residents; remove drops One from both; B's own search returns only Foreign. P1 ready.

Evidence: 2 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (our scripted spec, not written yet): it needs two fresh @roundai.test accounts made with the local admin key (owner and a foreign physician); dev has no admin key and one shared account, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
